svg.title: Which particles carry the salt? What the Pallas activation curves reveal beyond their midpoints
svg.desc: A chemical fit requires a greater salt fraction at 120 than at 50 nm on 8 of 27 dates using five published activation midpoints and on 12 using the full curves. Mean best-fit salt fractions from the full curves are 9.8% and 49.6% at 50 and 120 nm.
